title: DirAccess.make_dir_recursive() fails with error using absolute path in exported project
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.5.1.
Not reproducible in 3.6 as this functionality worked differently.

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6641) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 31.73 GiB memory

### Issue description

In an exported a project, if you create an instance of DirAccess using "res://" and then call make_dir_recursive(), it returns an error and fails to create the directories.

It works fine when running inside the editor.

`DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute()` seems to work fine.

### Steps to reproduce

Run the following lines of code *after exporting the project to Windows or Linux* (obviously if using Linux, change the path to something appropriate).

`var dir = DirAccess.open("res://")` 
`var res = dir.make_dir_recursive("c:/data2/data2")`

You will get the error:-

ERROR: Could not create directory: 'c:/data2'.
   at: (core/io/dir_access.cpp:178)

and res = 2 ("Unavailable error").

(Previously I thought it failed when using the line `var dir = DirAccess.open("c:/")` but this appears not to be the case.)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
